# 鐵道查詢 Taiwanrail

> Free real-time timetable, fare, stop and delay search for Taiwan's two rail
> systems — Taiwan Railways (TRA / 台鐵) and Taiwan High Speed Rail (THSR / 高鐵).
> Data comes from the Ministry of Transportation's official TDX open API. No
> sign-up required. The site is a PWA and works partly offline.

## Key facts

- Covers all TRA and THSR stations island-wide; search any origin–destination pair.
- Live data: train delays (TDX LiveBoard), cancellations/suspensions (TDX Alert), and THSR fares (TDX ODFare: standard / business / non-reserved).
- Metro transfer hints for Taipei MRT, Taoyuan Airport MRT, Taichung MRT, Kaohsiung MRT, light rail and BRT.
- Languages: Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant-TW) and English.
- Cost: completely free, no account needed.

## Popular routes (THSR / 高鐵)

- [Taipei → Zuoying 臺北到左營高鐵](https://taiwanrail.vercel.app/routes/hsr/taipei-to-zuoying/): fastest ~1h34, standard fare NT$1490.
- [Taipei → Taichung 臺北到臺中高鐵](https://taiwanrail.vercel.app/routes/hsr/taipei-to-taichung/): timetable, fare and stops.
- [Taipei → Tainan 臺北到臺南高鐵](https://taiwanrail.vercel.app/routes/hsr/taipei-to-tainan/): timetable, fare and stops.
- [Nangang → Zuoying 南港到左營高鐵](https://taiwanrail.vercel.app/routes/hsr/nangang-to-zuoying/): full-line timetable and fare.

## Popular routes (TRA / 台鐵)

- [Taipei → Kaohsiung 臺北到高雄台鐵](https://taiwanrail.vercel.app/routes/train/taipei-to-kaohsiung/): fastest direct train and daily frequency.
- [Taipei → Hualien 臺北到花蓮台鐵](https://taiwanrail.vercel.app/routes/train/taipei-to-hualien/): east-coast line timetable.
- [Taipei → Taichung 臺北到臺中台鐵](https://taiwanrail.vercel.app/routes/train/taipei-to-taichung/): timetable and stops.
- [Hualien → Taitung 花蓮到臺東台鐵](https://taiwanrail.vercel.app/routes/train/hualien-to-taitung/): east-coast line timetable.

## Primary entry points

- [Home / live search](https://taiwanrail.vercel.app/): pick any two stations for live TRA + THSR results.
- [English home](https://taiwanrail.vercel.app/en/): same tool, English UI.
- [Sitemap](https://taiwanrail.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): all indexable pages.

## Source & attribution

- 資料來源：[TDX 運輸資料流通服務平臺](https://tdx.transportdata.tw/)（交通部公開 API）；時刻表於每次部署更新，票價、誤點與停駛仍以 App 即時結果為準。
- Data source: [TDX 運輸資料流通服務平臺](https://tdx.transportdata.tw/) (Taiwan MOTC public API). Timetables refresh on each deploy; use live in-app results for current fares, delays and cancellations.
